mapper.sql: code, kind, title, content, owner_code, region, aliases, status, valid_from, valid_to, source_uri
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE graph AS ( SELECT 1 AS depth, #{code}::varchar AS from_code, CASE WHEN r.source_code = #{code} THEN r.relation ELSE 'INVERSE_' || r.relation END AS relation, CASE WHEN r.source_code = #{code} THEN r.target_code ELSE r.source_code END AS to_code, r.rationale, ARRAY[#{code}::varchar, CASE WHEN r.source_code = #{code} THEN r.target_code ELSE r.source_code END]::varchar[] AS path FROM public.knowledge_relations r WHERE r.source_code = #{code} OR r.target_code = #{code} UNION ALL SELECT g.depth + 1, g.to_code, CASE WHEN r.source_code = g.to_code THEN r.relation ELSE 'INVERSE_' || r.relation END, CASE WHEN r.source_code = g.to_code THEN r.target_code ELSE r.source_code END, r.rationale, g.path || CASE WHEN r.source_code = g.to_code THEN r.target_code ELSE r.source_code END FROM graph g JOIN public.knowledge_relations r ON (r.source_code = g.to_code OR r.target_code = g.to_code) WHERE g.depth < #{depth} AND NOT (CASE WHEN r.source_code = g.to_code THEN r.target_code ELSE r.source_code END = ANY(g.path)) ) SELECT g.depth, g.from_code, g.relation, g.to_code, g.rationale, i.title, i.kind FROM graph g JOIN public.knowledge_items i ON i.code = g.to_code WHERE i.valid_from <= #{asOf} AND (i.valid_to IS NULL OR i.valid_to > #{asOf}) ORDER BY g.depth, g.relation, g.to_code LIMIT #{limit}
